criteria.label: Phone as driving key
criteria.definition: Phone credential unlocks and authorises driving; remote app unlock and proximity fob are separate.

criteria.label: Local driver profiles
criteria.definition: Saved preferences and seat/mirror memory; scope must be identified.

criteria.label: Cloud profile transfer
criteria.definition: Preferences transferred between compatible vehicles through an account; not local seat memory.

criteria.label: Passive unlock
criteria.definition: Approach/handle entry without pressing a remote; state whether phone or fob.

criteria.label: Automatic start
criteria.definition: No start-button workflow, including required brake/gear steps.

criteria.label: Automatic shutdown
criteria.definition: Exit/lock-triggered power-down; distinguish timers and retained climate.

criteria.label: Walk-away lock
criteria.definition: Vehicle locks when authorised key leaves, subject to settings.

criteria.label: Remote cabin preconditioning
criteria.definition: App/fob/scheduled cabin heating or cooling; not inherently battery fast-charge preparation.

criteria.label: Automatic seat climate
criteria.definition: Temperature/occupancy-based automatic seat heating/ventilation; hardware alone is insufficient.

criteria.label: Front heated seats
criteria.definition: Selected trim's front-seat heating.

criteria.label: Front ventilated seats
criteria.definition: Fan ventilation distinguished from refrigerated cooling.

criteria.label: Rear heated seats
criteria.definition: Identify heated positions and trim conditions.

criteria.label: Heated steering wheel
criteria.definition: Selected trim's wheel heating; automatic mode separate.

criteria.label: Media resumption
criteria.definition: Actual resume behaviour by source/account; universal automatic playback is not assumed.

criteria.label: Integrated garage opener
criteria.definition: Vehicle-integrated radio or connected opener; external handheld remote does not qualify.

criteria.label: Predictive gear selection
criteria.definition: Automatic selection of Drive/Reverse; automatic transmission or automatic Park does not qualify.

criteria.label: Standard driver assistance
criteria.definition: Specify adaptive cruise, lane centring, parking and safety functions without equating capability.

criteria.label: Optional driver assistance
criteria.definition: Paid or trim-dependent extra assistance, with Australian hardware/software eligibility.

criteria.label: Power-folding mirrors
criteria.definition: Hardware plus any separately verified automatic/location workflow.

criteria.label: Parked event recording
criteria.definition: Recorded footage while parked, distinguished from alarm, live view and surround cameras.

criteria.label: Driving video recording
criteria.definition: Built-in road recording or optional accessory; Sentry alone does not establish this.

criteria.label: Dedicated Pet Mode
criteria.definition: Retained climate with pet-specific operating/display behaviour; upholstery is not Pet Mode.

criteria.label: Camp / Utility Mode
criteria.definition: Retained climate/accessory power with operating and security conditions.

criteria.label: Cabin overheat protection
criteria.definition: Separate automatic parked cabin-temperature protection feature.

criteria.label: Remote parking / summon
criteria.definition: Distinguish straight-line remote parking from pathfinding vehicle-to-owner summon.

criteria.label: Phone contacts
criteria.definition: Bluetooth/account contacts and calling, subject to handset permission.

criteria.label: Green-light departure chime
criteria.definition: Signal-change alert; front-vehicle departure alert is recorded as a different capability.

criteria.label: Alert sound quality
criteria.definition: Preference/test-required; delivered sound changes can be factual.

criteria.label: Charge-port operation
criteria.definition: Manual push flap, powered cover and automatic opening/closing workflows distinguished.

criteria.label: Vehicle-to-load
criteria.definition: External AC power, rated output, adapter and hardware eligibility; not USB/12V or V2G.

criteria.label: Tesla Supercharger access
criteria.definition: Australian site/connector access and integration; selected open sites do not equal whole-network access.

criteria.label: OTA scope
criteria.definition: Vehicle systems that can change remotely; delivered release evidence separate from promised capability.

criteria.label: EV route planning
criteria.definition: Automatic charging itinerary, arrival SOC and live charger data distinguished from ordinary maps.

criteria.label: Navigation-triggered battery conditioning
criteria.definition: Battery thermal preparation for a supported DC charging destination; manual warming is separate.

criteria.label: ANCAP safety rating
criteria.definition: Stars, assessment year and generation/variant applicability; unrated does not mean zero stars.

criteria.label: Ride and control feel
criteria.definition: Matched driving test required; suspension equipment is an objective subfact.

criteria.label: Interior fit and finish
criteria.definition: Materials/equipment versus inspected assembly quality and durability.

criteria.label: Styling and refinement
criteria.definition: Subjective design preference; dated design/hardware changes separately recorded.

criteria.label: Battery energy density
criteria.definition: Pack Wh/kg or Wh/L with measurement basis; cell-level claims and battery capacity are separate.

criteria.label: Rear motor / Performance hardware
criteria.definition: Document rear-motor hardware and whether a claimed Performance-specific upgrade applies to selected trim.

criteria.label: Voice assistant
criteria.definition: Native command coverage and generative assistant availability, with software/connectivity limits.

criteria.label: Paint choices and quality
criteria.definition: Available colours/costs versus inspected finish and durability.

criteria.label: Practical storage
criteria.definition: Rear seats-up boot, frunk and folded-seat maximum stored separately with measurement basis.

criteria.label: Referral program
criteria.definition: Dated regional promotional terms; not a permanent vehicle feature.

criteria.label: Apple CarPlay / Android Auto
criteria.definition: Factory integration, wired/wireless and update conditions.

criteria.label: Connected vehicle app
criteria.definition: Remote commands, key, status, connectivity subscription and coverage.

criteria.label: Heat pump
criteria.definition: Verified selected-trim heat-pump hardware, not generic climate control.

criteria.label: Servicing
criteria.definition: Service interval and published service pricing.

criteria.label: Driveaway price
criteria.definition: Published or estimated price including delivery, stamp duty, registration and compulsory insurance, with the state named.

criteria.label: Novated lease and FBT
criteria.definition: Fringe benefits tax treatment for a salary-packaged car now and under the changes legislated from 1 April 2027.

criteria.label: Insurance cost
criteria.definition: Published comprehensive premium benchmarks with the driver profile named; not a personal quote.

criteria.label: Resale value
criteria.definition: Guaranteed future value programs and published retained-value evidence; forecasts are not guarantees.

criteria.label: Roadside assistance
criteria.definition: Length and conditions of the maker's roadside cover.

criteria.label: Service network
criteria.definition: Australian service locations and mobile servicing, dated.

criteria.label: Driver-monitoring and speed alerts
criteria.definition: How attention and speed-limit warnings behave, whether they can be quietened and whether the setting survives a restart.

criteria.label: Parking cameras and sensors
criteria.definition: Reversing or 360-degree camera and parking sensors on the selected trim.

criteria.label: Real-world range
criteria.definition: Independent on-road range results, with the tester and protocol named; not a laboratory figure.

criteria.label: Energy use
criteria.definition: Official energy consumption with its test basis, and a yearly cost at stated assumptions.

criteria.label: Battery chemistry
criteria.definition: Cell chemistry and the maker's everyday charge-limit advice.

criteria.label: Home charging time
criteria.definition: Time to charge on a single-phase 7 kW wallbox, the usual Australian home set-up.

criteria.label: Charging cables included
criteria.definition: Portable charger and cables supplied with the car.

criteria.label: Home and grid power (V2H/V2G)
criteria.definition: Whether the car can power a house or export to the grid in Australia; vehicle-to-load is a separate row.

criteria.label: Child-seat anchor points
criteria.definition: ISOFIX and top-tether positions, and known fitting limits.

criteria.label: Spare tyre
criteria.definition: Spare wheel, repair kit or neither.

criteria.label: Screens and head-up display
criteria.definition: Centre screen, driver display, rear screen and head-up display on the selected trim.

criteria.label: Sound system
criteria.definition: Speaker count and branded audio on the selected trim.

criteria.label: Glass roof and shade
criteria.definition: Fixed or opening glass roof and whether a blind is fitted.

criteria.label: Powered tailgate
criteria.definition: Powered opening and closing on the selected trim.

criteria.label: Wireless phone charging
criteria.definition: Wireless charging pads and their rated output.

publicationIssues.title: Model Y L has its own ANCAP rating
publicationIssues.publication_action: L scores 84%, with explicit child-restraint installation cautions.

publicationIssues.title: Model Y L acceleration: launch versus current order
publicationIssues.publication_action: Current 4.5 seconds is a reported configuration figure; launch was 5.0 seconds. Obtain a dated Australian order quote.

publicationIssues.title: Tesla dimension discrepancies
publicationIssues.publication_action: Australian manual: L 4,976 mm; other material: 4,969 mm. Premium manual: 4,790 mm excluding plate bracket; earlier retail record: 4,792 mm. Preserve measurement basis.

publicationIssues.title: Tesla V2L source conflict
publicationIssues.publication_action: The current AU manual is configuration-dependent, while the AU shop still restricts its adapter to Model Y L. Five-seat V2L needs VIN/build and adapter confirmation.

publicationIssues.title: EV3 software count requires qualification
publicationIssues.publication_action: Six notices were recovered on the current retrieved manufacturer index. The prior July and September records could not be reverified. Keep two pending records, not an unqualified count of eight.

publicationIssues.title: EV3 GT-Line AWD remains provisional in this dataset
publicationIssues.publication_action: Australian launch reporting exists, but the retrievable manufacturer trim sheet still lists four FWD variants.

publicationIssues.title: ATTO 3 EVO document rechecked; remaining limits
publicationIssues.publication_action: The official AU specification PDF was retrieved on 6 October and the displayed numeric technical fields rechecked. Price, unreviewed equipment and ANCAP applicability remain separate checks; no legacy rating is inherited.

publicationIssues.title: Atto 3 EVO ANCAP applicability is unresolved
publicationIssues.publication_action: Do not assign the outgoing Atto 3 2022 rating to EVO without an explicit ANCAP applicability statement.

publicationIssues.title: Zeekr Black Edition range and wheels
publicationIssues.publication_action: Manufacturer confirms Performance base. Reported 20-inch wheels and price are not an independently retrieved OEM price list.

publicationIssues.title: Prices are not uniform driveaway quotations
publicationIssues.publication_action: Prices are dated base/list records or reported figures. Obtain a postcode-specific quote, including delivery, order fees, options and state on-road charges.

publicationIssues.title: Public software histories are not VIN histories
publicationIssues.publication_action: Minimum evidence counts use different units. Model Y L FSD activation must be confirmed separately: June validation-delay reporting does not establish the current activation status and is not an OTA delivery.

publicationIssues.title: Feature inheritance is not direct verification
publicationIssues.publication_action: The matrix contains explicit trim resolutions, conditional family evidence and unknowns. Its 1,632 rows are not 1,632 new independent verifications.

publicationIssues.title: Charging windows and supply ratings differ
publicationIssues.publication_action: A 350 kW supply used in a Kia test does not establish a 350 kW vehicle peak.

publicationIssues.title: Geely Extended Range is a hardware change
publicationIssues.publication_action: Current 68.39 kWh equipment must not be automatically applied to older 60.22 kWh vehicles. The larger battery is not an OTA update.

publicationIssues.title: No matched physical or road testing
publicationIssues.publication_action: The specification research does not establish objective winners for paint quality, assembly consistency, ride comfort or alert sounds.

factStatus.conditional: Value holds only under stated conditions (see qualifications/conditions)
factStatus.not_verified: Unknown. null/Needs confirmation - never zero or absent
factStatus.optional: Available as an option, not standard

buyerGrade.confirmed: Stated by an authoritative Australian source for this exact version
buyerGrade.check: Supported but needs buyer confirmation (range, sibling, brand-wide terms, etc.)
buyerGrade.not_published: Searched with two cited sources and not found - an earned 'not published'

availability.current_or_order_listed: Advertised current or orderable Australian version
availability.outgoing: Being phased out; may still have new stock
availability.announced_provisional: Announced, not yet confirmed on sale
availability.not_current: Retained decision that the version is not current

buyerAvailability.on_sale_now: Advertised current version (never proof of physical stock or accepted orders)
buyerAvailability.order_open_or_arriving: Pre-order / orders accepted / stated arrival window

orderStatus.accepting_orders: Official Australian trim-specific Order Now or explicit dated order-opening evidence; physical stock not implied.
orderStatus.preorder: Explicit reservation/preorder before confirmed local delivery.
orderStatus.listed_unconfirmed: Current Australian listing/configuration or dealer evidence; order acceptance not directly established.
orderStatus.not_current: Not verified in current factory-order range; may be announced/interest-only or outgoing with residual stock unknown.
orderStatus.accepting_order_requests_advertised: Named NEW retail offer accepts enquiries or order requests; seller acceptance, delivered specification and timing remain unconfirmed.

researchStage.partial: Added exact-trim records; some cells still unverified

tier: Tier 1 = vehicleClass passenger or ute. Tier 2 = vans, trucks, buses, motorcycles, other. 'On sale' = current_or_order_listed, or outgoing with sourced new-stock listing.
